description: This file defines the Directory class within the Todaymade\Daux\Tree namespace. It manages directory entries, provides sorting functionalities, retrieves index and first pages, and implements PHP's ArrayAccess and IteratorAggregate interfaces for directory traversal.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory in a content tree, supporting sorting, navigation, and content checks.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts the directory entries based on custom rules, separating them into buckets and ordering accordingly.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns all child entries within the directory.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a new Entry as a child to the directory.

methods.name: removeChild
methods.description: Removes a specified Entry from the directory.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object related to this directory.

methods.name: getLocalIndexPage
methods.description: Fetches the local index page of the directory if it exists.

methods.name: getIndexPage
methods.description: Returns the index page if available, or seeks an inherited or first page.

methods.name: seekFirstPage
methods.description: Recursively searches for the first available content page in descendants.

methods.name: getFirstPage
methods.description: Gets the first content page in the directory or its descendants.

methods.name: setFirstPage
methods.description: Sets the first page reference for the directory.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the directory or its descendants contain any content.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a dump of the directory structure for debugging or analysis.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific offset exists in the children array.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a child Entry by offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a child Entry at a specific offset.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes a child Entry at a specific offset.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the directory's children.
